prompt: Macro close-up of a paper coffee cup held out from a sleeping bag on a wet pavement by a bare, chapped hand: the cup is empty of coins and slowly filling with rain, drops making rings on the water inside, the rim sharp, the passing legs behind soft and out of focus. Flat grey overcast winter daylight in a near-future Britain, muted cold colour, drizzle in the air; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
